create_timer_benchmark: create a Timer instance with stmt='x + y' and globals for broadcasting add benchmark
run_timer_timeit: run the Timer.timeit method to execute a benchmark for a fixed number of iterations
run_timer_autorange: run the Timer.blocked_autorange method to auto-determine iterations and execute benchmark
configure_timer_globals: configure Timer globals with torch tensors for benchmark statement execution context
run_benchmark_example: run the simple_timeit example module to demonstrate Timer API usage with repeated runs
